title: Five Data Systems, Five Different Counts
description: Regina tracks its lead service connections across at least five public data systems. None agree on the count. Nobody has reconciled them.

systems.name: CBMH WaterConnection
systems.note: Field survey ground truth — but frozen at 2016. Bulk import in 2009, minor updates through 2016, nothing after.

systems.name: DomesticWaterNetworkTrace
systems.note: Live administrative records updated through 2026. Has UPDATE_DATE and MAINTENANCEDATE fields.

systems.name: SewerWaterCondition Lead+PolyB
systems.note: Filtered view showing only ACTIVE Pb and POLY B connections. The city's current operational tracking layer.

systems.name: LeadConnectionAreas
systems.note: Community-level aggregate. No date stamp. The '3,637 baseline' cited on the city website. Includes connections already replaced.

systems.name: GTLO Committee List
systems.source: City of Regina → Get The Lead Out Committee
systems.note: Addresses provided by the City to the GTLO committee, Sept 2025. Google Maps capped export at 2,000. Our bridge matched 98.1%.

error_model.method: CBMH(Pb) cross Trace(Cu) crossover with MAINTENANCEDATE validation against city-reported LSC Replacements
error_model.batch_entry_example: January 23, 2024: 2,021 records entered in one day

key_finding: The city's GIS records 84.1% of completed replacements. The remaining 16% are never entered. This is systematic — the same rate every year — proving an institutional data management gap, not random clerical error.
